questions.solution:
def merge_sort(arr):

        return arr
    mid = len(arr) // 2
    left = merge_sort(arr[:mid])
    right = merge_sort(arr[mid:])
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] < right[j]:
            result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(left[i:])
    result.extend(right[j:])

questions.solution:
n = 3
matrix = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
top, bottom, left, right = 0, n - 1, 0, n - 1
num = 1
while top <= bottom and left <= right:
    for j in range(left, right + 1):
        matrix[top][j] = num
        num += 1
    top += 1
    for i in range(top, bottom + 1):
        matrix[i][right] = num
        num += 1
    right -= 1

questions.description: 求 4x4 网格的路径数（只能向右向下）。

questions.code_template:
nums = [1, 2, 4, 6, 8]
target = 10
left, right = 0, len(nums) - 1
result = None
while left < right:
    total = nums[left] + nums[right]
    if total == target:
        result = [left, right]
        break
    elif total < target:
        left += 1
    else:
        right -= 1
print(___)
